bio: In the mood for fresh Italian cuisine that skilfully combines typical cucina casalinga with modern influences? The select ingredients are seasonal, with fish and seafood as the focal point. The ikejime dry-aged sea bass, for example, from the restaurant's own maturing cabinet, is excellent. In addition to the à la carte menu, patron Ingmar Goetzloff will talk you through the latest creations at your table. He will also be happy to advise you on drinks – they have a nicely curated wine list with around 400 labels. The modern, attractively decorated restaurant is located in a residential and office area close to the main railway station and Landestheater....
